steps.text: Against your better judgement, you pick up the bottle and take a sip...
...and immediately black out.

steps.player: Urrrrrgh!
I feel like I've just been kicked off Entrana.
Hey there, little guy! Aww, look at you! You're so cute!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: No, I'm not.

steps.player: Aaaaaaaaaah! You can talk!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Of course I can! I'm ugly, not stupid.

steps.player: Wait, what? You're not ugly! You're adorable! What makes you think you're ugly?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I stand corrected. I am here getting therapy from a huge fleshy thing I just found on the beach, which quite frankly I should have run from. I must also be stupid.

steps.player: Hey now, you shouldn't be so harsh on yourself. Even dubious decisions can turn out well. For instance, I just drank from this random bottle I found, which sounds like a terrible idea.
And, to be honest, feels like a terrible idea too. Urgh. I now have a pounding headache...

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I'm still waiting for the bit where this wasn't a terrible idea.

steps.player: I got to meet you!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I'm STILL waiting for the bit where this wasn't a terrible idea.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Hang on, if you thought it was going to be such a terrible idea, why did you even do it?

steps.player: I felt... strangely compelled to? It's hard to explain. I just had the conviction that I needed to do it, no matter the consequences.

steps.text: If the player has NPC attack options enabled:

steps.player: It happens sometimes... I feel the urge to do something daft, like attacking someone I wanted to talk to. Sometimes I can resist it, and sometimes I can't.

steps.text: If the player has NPC attack options disabled:

steps.player: It happens sometimes... I feel the urge to do something daft, like running in the complete opposite direction to where I wanted to go. Sometimes I can resist it, and sometimes I can't.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Something tells me that I shouldn't take advice from you.

steps.player: Sure, I make mistakes, but learning from mistakes makes you wiser!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Are you learning, though? Because I am learning nothing from this.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Listen, you can rest here for a little while, but we'll be needing the beach back very soon for the ceremony.

steps.player: The ceremony? What ceremony?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: You're not from around here, are you? Very well, then, I will explain.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Every year, my kin comes down from the heights and gathers on the beach. There, we perform the ceremonial dance and build sand nests to try and find a mate.

steps.player: Wait... Is this literally a dating site?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Yes. And every...
The crab painstakingly counts up to 16 on his claws.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: 100 years, the turnout is significantly bigger. Legends say that they're echoes of a time where our population boomed. One of those ceremonies will happen in a couple of days.

steps.player: Sounds like it's going to be quite the party!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.player: You don't sound convinced.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Let's say I've not had a good experience in the past. I... don't really want to talk about it.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: If only I could be a ceremonial leader, then maybe...

steps.player: A ceremonial leader? What do they do?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Ceremonial leaders are the ones performing the ceremonial rhythm. Without them, the dance isn't synchronised and the ceremony descends into chaos.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That usually results in some crabs complaining loudly about how much they paid to be there.

steps.player: Wait... You have to pay to attend?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: For the most part, no, but if you want to avoid any risk of being trampled, there are sections of the beach which are more exclusive. Personally, I think being mildly trampled is part of the experience.

steps.player: I see. Anyhow, why do you wish to become a ceremonial leader?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Ceremonial leaders are respected and looked up to as long as they lead the ceremony successfully. It's not usually my thing to stand in front of others, but maybe that's what it takes.

steps.player: What it takes for what?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: To finally be seen...
The crab's voice trails off as he looks up towards the trees and his face, somehow, appears to turn redder.

steps.player: Er... How does one become a ceremonial leader, then?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: You need an instrument. Usually either seashell or coconut, but good seashells can be hard to find.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Say... Even though you only have 2 legs, they're pretty long. You could probably walk around the island and find good shells in no time!

steps.player: I suppose. How many do we need?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: As many different ones as you can find. Bring them here and I'll try them out.

steps.player: Okay, then! I'll be back.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: See ya!
You decide against drinking from the bottle after all.

drinking-from-bottle-attempting-to-board.text: The headache from drinking from the bottle on the beach makes it difficult to find your boat. You feel that swigging from that bottle again would fix it.

drinking-from-bottle-attempting-to-telep.text: The headache from drinking from the bottle stops you from remembering how to teleport. Drinking from the bottle again may help with this.

drinking-from-bottle-drinking-from-the-b.text: A second dose of drink may let you remember where you moored your boat and how to teleport, but also make you forget about crabs a little.

steps.text: Against your better judgement, you pick up the bottle and take a sip...
...and immediately black out.
Your headache seems to have cleared a little. You remember where you moored your boat.

drinking-from-bottle-drinking-from-the-b.text: Against your better judgement, you pick up the bottle and take a sip...
You wake up with a headache.

drinking-from-bottle-attempting-to-pickl.player: What if I'm currently dreaming? I won't get to keep anything I find. It's not worth it.

drinking-from-bottle-attempting-to-drop-.text: You're not even sure any of this is real. You probably can't drop your items here, even if you wanted to.

drinking-from-bottle-interacting-with-th.player: I am not touching that without a good reason.

handing-in-seashells.text: If the player does not have any seashells:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: No luck finding shells? There should be some on the beach or around the island.

handing-in-seashells.text: If the player has one seashell:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Looks like you have a seashell with you! Let me take it off you!
If the player has already turned in that seashell:

handing-in-seashells.text: If the player has multiple seashells:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Looks like you have some seashells with you! Let me take them off you!
If the player has already turned in those seashells:

handing-in-seashells-large-rose-shell.text: You hand in a really large rose shell.

handing-in-seashells-black-and-white-she.text: You hand in a cool black and white shell.

handing-in-seashells-vivid-orange-shell.text: You hand in a vivid orange shell.

handing-in-seashells-bright-yellow-shell.text: You hand in a bright yellow shell.

handing-in-seashells-exotic-looking-shel.text: You hand in an exotic-looking shell.

handing-in-seashells-unassuming-cream-sh.text: You hand in an unassuming cream shell.

handing-in-seashells-tiny-white-shell.text: You hand in a tiny white shell.

handing-in-seashells-bad-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-bad-shell.text: That one sounds absolutely awful. Yeet!
The crab tosses the bad shell into the sea.

handing-in-seashells-first-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-first-correct-shell.text: Acceptable. I'm going to try it out while you look for some more.

handing-in-seashells-second-correct-shel.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-second-correct-shel.text: That's cool. Keep at it! We're going to need quite a few more.

handing-in-seashells-third-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-third-correct-shell.text: Nice! We've got 3 notes so far. There's got to be some more shells out there.

handing-in-seashells-fourth-correct-shel.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-fourth-correct-shel.text: Cheers! We've got 10 different notes. That beats the last ceremony, but we can do better still.

handing-in-seashells-fourth-correct-shel.player: Wait, what do you mean, 10? We just had 3 with the last shell I brought!

handing-in-seashells-fourth-correct-shel.text: The crab points at each finger on his claws in turn.

handing-in-seashells-fourth-correct-shel.player: Do you know what...? Never mind!

handing-in-seashells-fifth-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-fifth-correct-shell.text: Oh, very nice! We now have... 11 notes. A couple more might be enough.

handing-in-seashells-sixth-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-sixth-correct-shell.text: Thank you! We've almost got enough to make a tune. One more?

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.text: Oh no... I can't easily play 13 different shells on my own, but if I only play one... I won't stand out enough for her to see me!

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.text: Never mind! Every other ceremonial leader will use either seashells or coconuts. Maybe I'd stand out more if I played something else...

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.player: I don't think that counts. We can't have a wind instrument. We don't want a percussive instrument. How about a string instrument?
A string instrument. The string vibrates and makes a sound.

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.text: Sounds cool! I want to try one.
If the player has a regular lyre in their inventory:

steps.player: Well, it just so happens that I have a lyre with me right here!
You run your claw along one of the strings like this.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Let me at it!
You place the lyre on the sand. The crab awkwardly plucks a string and a clear note rings.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That's really cool! It's a bit high-pitched, however.

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.text: If the player has an enchanted lyre in their inventory:

steps.player: Well, it just so happens that I have a lyre with me right here!
I should warn you, there is a possibilty that you will get teleported to a land far far away if you play it.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I... think I'm going to give it a pass.

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.text: Can you make one that makes a nice deep sound with what you find around here? There's rubbish over there floating in the sea.

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.speaker: Crab
handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.text: In fact, it would be great if you could clean it out, it makes the place look untidy.

handing-in-seashells-last-correct-shell.player: I'll see what I can do.

making-the-string-instrument-fishing-up-.text: If the player does not have a big fishing net:

steps.text: You need a big net to gather items from this floatsam.

making-the-string-instrument-fishing-up-.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You can't carry any more floatsam.

making-the-string-instrument-fishing-up-.text: You catch a small battered barrel.
You catch a weathered rosewood plank.

making-the-string-instrument-using-other.text: To make a string instrument, you'll also need a sound box to amplify the sound and a frame or fretboard to tense the string.

making-the-string-instrument-combining-t.text: You fashion a makeshift string instrument out of the flotsam.

making-the-string-instrument-handing-in-.text: If the player hasn't fished all 3 materials yet:

steps.player: Not yet. I can't remember where I was supposed to look.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Could you fish what you need from that floating rubbish?

steps.player: Ah yes, that was it!

making-the-string-instrument-handing-in-.text: If the player has all 3 materials:

steps.player: Not yet, but I do have all that's needed to make one. Give me a second.

making-the-string-instrument-handing-in-.text: If the player fished all 3 materials but no longer has them:

steps.player: Not yet, and I've lost the materials to make it.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Don't worry, floatsam never stays away from this island for very long. Yep, there it is!

making-the-string-instrument-handing-in-.text: If the player dropped the instrument:

steps.player: I made it, but then I lost it...

steps.text: If the player has the ingredients to make another:

steps.player: I do have all that's needed to make another one, however. Give me a second.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the ingredients to make another:

steps.player: And I don't have all the materials I need to make it anymore.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Luckily, the rubbish didn't stay away from our island for long. Maybe you can just fish the materials for another one.

making-the-string-instrument-handing-in-.text: If the player has the instrument:

steps.player: Yes! It's right here. Let me give it to you.

steps.text: You give the instrument to the crab.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Oh wow, that is a nice instrument. What do you call it?

steps.player: It's a disaster!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: It's got a very cool name, too!

steps.player: It's a bass!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: You can't fool me. A bass is a type of fish and this looks nothing like a fish.

steps.player: No that's a bass. THIS is a BASS. It's pronounced differently.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That would explain the weird accent.

steps.player: I don't know. Why don't you name it?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Hmmm... For some reason the name Banjo calls to me.

steps.player: What are the chances? A banjo is actually also a string instrument.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That's amazing. I like it because it sounds funny to me. Banjo!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: How do you play it?

steps.player: Let me show you!

steps.text: You show the crab how to pluck the string, and how to change the pitch of the note by pressing the string at the same time. The crab tries to copy you, but can only really produce one note.
You kindly tense the string a bit more to tune the instrument to the pitch of the shells. The crab starts practising.

steps.player: I can try and explain. You pluck the string and you make a noise. You might be able to change the pitch by making the string shorter somehow.

steps.text: The crab tries to copy you, but can only really produce one note. He starts practising.

steps.player: I don't actually know.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I will experiment, then!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: While I do this, could you find some more crabs willing to be ceremonial leaders? The sooner we start practising together, the better we will sound.

steps.player: Any idea where to look?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I would check next to bushes and trees. You may find some of us hiding in some. We crabs can be scared of tall things which are not trees.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: If you struggle to make contact, you may want to make yourself flatter to the ground.

steps.player: Got it!

crab-hunting-talking-to-the-crab-again.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-talking-to-the-crab-again.text: Pretty good! While I do this, could you find some more crabs willing to be ceremonial leaders? The sooner we start practising together, the better we will sound.

crab-hunting-talking-to-the-crab-again.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-talking-to-the-crab-again.text: I would check next to bushes and trees. You may find some of us hiding in some. We crabs can be scared of tall things which are not trees.

crab-hunting-talking-to-the-crab-again.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-talking-to-the-crab-again.text: If you struggle to make contact, you may want to make yourself flatter to the ground.

crab-hunting-investigating-a-tree-plant-.text: The crab that was in this tree is currently wandering around.
The crab that was in this tree has left to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: No crab is coming out of the tree. Maybe they are too scared?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.player: Hello! I'm looking for ceremonial leaders on behalf of my friend on the beach.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: My reputation precedes me, I see? Of course you would be told to visit us. My family and I have been ceremonial leaders for generations.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: While you're here, shall I give you a tour of the estate? My lineage has been living in this magic tree for at least 200 years.
If the player has 75 Woodcutting or higher:

steps.player: It's a very nice tree. I could get quite a few logs from it.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: If the player doesn't have at least 75 Woodcutting:

steps.player: It's a very nice tree.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: If the player has talked to the crab that suggests the player could be their kid:

steps.player: Talking to another crab, I was under the impression crabs have no idea which crab they are related to.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Oh, that is definitely true for the majority of crabs. These plebs are classless and will breed with whoever they fancy.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: On the other hand, we don't mingle. Our ceremony takes place on an exclusive section of beach. We grow up in a private tide pool. Our bloodline is pure.

steps.player: Er...

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.player: Anyway, what instrument do you play?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: Seashell, of course. We are not so coarse as to bash coconuts. Now playing shell... That requires some finesse that only the most delicate crab can manage.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.player: Sounds like you should play the smallest shell then. That one definitely requires finesse.
If you would kindly like to make your way to the beach, you can show the other crabs how it's done.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: Naturally, I will go there right away! They can't possibly get this right without some proper directions.
The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: Terribly. These oafs won't take my suggestions into account. I'm having to play their unrefined tune and it is most unbecoming.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.player: Actually, it sounds nice to me.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.text: Well, of course I sound nice. I have had many years of practice. These so-and-sos, however...

crab-hunting-investigating-the-magic-tre.player: Hey, these are nice crabs. Try to get along or I may feel the urge to acquire some magic logs.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: No crab is coming out of the tree. Maybe they are too scared?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.player: Hey hey! It's okay, I'm not going to hurt you.
My crab friend on the beach is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: That's not how it's done! There are ceremonial leaders and we pick who joins us, not the other way around.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.player: But he has a cool new instrument for himself and a collection of nice shells for other leaders.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: He does? I suppose that might qualify him if he can keep a rhythm. Are any of the shells going spare?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.player: I believe so, yes. Will you be joining him?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: This is highly irregular! But I suppose I should.
The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: You were right, that instrument of his is pretty cool. It should be a good year.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.player: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach. He's looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: Ceremonial leaders? Oh they are all so awesome! Putting themselves out there to make music for the ceremony like that, it's so selfless!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: I like them all so much I carve their portraits on my tree. I go to all of the ceremonies. I even got a ceremonial shell once, scratched by the leader! I almost fainted!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.player: Can I convince you to join them this year?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-sout.text: Being among my idols would be my dream, but it would kind of ruin the magic. I prefer just being in the crowd watching the show!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.text: No crab is coming out of the tree. Maybe they are too scared?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.player: Hello! I'm looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders on behalf of my crab friend on the beach.
I see where you're coming from, but I promise. Anything I can do to convince you?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.text: Yes! Please demonstrate the ceremonial dance to me.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.player: Anything else I can do to convince you? I can count, for example.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That's ridiculous, I won't hear another word from you.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I'll give it to you, you can count. But I'm going to need more than that before I believe you.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Answer this question: How often do we witness super-ceremonies?

steps.player: Every 16 years.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: No. You don't know enough about my kin. Begone.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: No. You don't know enough about my kin. Begone.

steps.player: Every 100 years.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: It could be luck, but you did give me the correct answer.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Where does our ceremony take place?

steps.player: On the beach.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Correct again! Hmm. My destination is 100 paces to the east and 12 paces to the south. How many paces would that be if I was a bird that flew straight there?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I haven't figured out how to solve it, but I don't know what this '42' is that you speak of. I think you just made that up. Begone!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I can't possibly tell whether it's the correct answer. I haven't figured out how to solve it.

steps.player: I have a good feeling about it.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Maybe bashing on a coconut repeatedly would help me discover the answer to this problem. Fine, I will help.
The crab scutters away to practise.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I can't possibly tell whether it's the correct answer. I haven't figured out how to solve it.

steps.player: I have a good feeling about it.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Maybe bashing on a coconut repeatedly would help me discover the answer to this problem. Fine, I will help.
The crab scutters away to practise.

options.text: You can't possibly expect me to know that!

steps.player: You can't possibly expect me to know that!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I suppose not. Even I don't have the answer.

steps.text: Maybe bashing on a coconut repeatedly would help me discover the answer to this problem. Fine, I will help.

steps.player: In the sea.

steps.text: No. You don't know enough about my kin. Begone.

I was told, but I wasn't listening.

steps.text: That's ridiculous, I won't hear another word from you.

options.text: I can count on you to join!

steps.player: I can count on you to join!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I'll admit, that was smooth. I'm still not convinced it's not some kind of trap.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Answer this question: How often do we witness super-ceremonies?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-tree-nort.text: I've been too busy bashing a coconut to worry about mathematics. It is very cathartic.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.player: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach. He's looking for ceremonial leaders to join him this year.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.text: The crab squints, then clicks its claws frantically.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.player: What's this? Has Timmy fallen down the old well?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.text: The crab scowls, then clicks its claws some more.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.text: Cliiick-cliiick-click click cliiick. Click-cliiick-click-click cliiick- cliiick-cliiick click-click-click cliiick.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.player: That's some pretty deft clawwork you've got there. Have you ever thought of playing shell? I think you have what it takes.
Sounds like you agree! So you'll do it?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.text: The crab viciously attacks your foot.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.player: You want to shake hands! Awww.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.text: The crab despondently throws its claws in the air, then scutters away to join the practice.
The crab viciously attacks your foot.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-m.player: Awww. Sorry little buddy, but I can't be an instrument for the band! You have a lovely shell right there, however!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: A crab appears!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Earthquake! Earthquake!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: No, no, it's okay! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Talking earthquake!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Would you please listen to me?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Angry talking earthquake!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Fine. The angry talking earthquake bids you to become a ceremonial leader this year. Do my bidding, or else!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: As you wish, as you wish! Please do not destroy my home!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Head to the beach to collect your shell.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: As you wish! Although I prefer playing coconut...

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Then head to the beach to collect your coconut! Do not anger me again!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Oh no, the angry talking earthquake is back!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Yes, and I tell you to keep practising!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: As you wish, as you wish!
A crab appears!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Oh! Is he cute?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: I think he's adorable, but then I think you all are. No, I'm here because he was looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Shame, girls can't be ceremonial leaders. Although I think it's stupid and we should be able to be leaders if we wanted. It's ridiculous.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: I can't see why you wouldn't be allowed to be a leader. Why don't you go and have a go, and if you being a girl is a problem, let me know. I'll talk to them.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Wow, you're pretty cool, whatever you are!
The crab scutters away to practise.
If the crab playing coconut is not present:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: This is fun!

steps.player: Good to hear!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: If the crab playing coconut is present:

steps.player: See, girl! I told you girls could be ceremonial leaders!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I'm so glad you did! I am having so much fun! I should do this every year!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Also, the crab playing coconut next to me is super cute! I'm so glad I came.

crab-hunting-talking-to-the-main-crab-be.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-talking-to-the-main-crab-be.text: While you were away, I heard of a commotion near the northernmost tree on the island. Could you please check it out?

crab-hunting-talking-to-the-main-crab-be.player: I didn't notice anything, but I will go and check.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the... Hey, wait a minute! You're not a crab. You're a penguin!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: 'Crab'
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: My cover has been blown! Unless you are also an agent in disguise? What's the passphrase?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: No, you've been caught red-handed. Come clean, now, what are you doing here!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: 'Crab'
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: The details of my mission must remain a secret. You can't make me talk.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: This island is covered in crabs. I am sure I could find a way to get that info out of you.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: 'Crab'
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: I'll talk, I'll talk! I've been sent on a mission to find food supplies for my homeland. I discovered that an upcoming ceremony will convince many crabs to come out of hiding.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: You want to eat the crabs? I won't let you. Now you better scram or I'm going to make you regret coming here.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: The player kicks the penguin into the ocean.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: Yo! The angry bird... Did it go?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: I kicked him out. We can't have him disrupt the ceremony, now, can we?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: That's so rad! I was afraid I'd have to miss out! I've been practising my moves all year, it would have been so off beat to miss out. I've been trialling a shell spin that's going to turn heads!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: That sounds amazing! Does that mean I can't convince you to become a ceremonial leader this year?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: Yo, now I didn't say that! Being a leader is an even bigger honour than being a dancer. You're one with the beat. I couldn't pass that up!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: Excellent! Then if you could head down to the beach, you'll find what you need to practise!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: Yo! This tune is going to be so good, I'm going to regret not being able to dance it.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.player: I would have loved to see it!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-northern-.text: Heh! My shell spin doesn't work on dry sand anyway! I know, I tried!

crab-hunting-returning-to-the-main-crab-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-returning-to-the-main-crab-.text: We could do with, er, more girl leaders.

crab-hunting-returning-to-the-main-crab-.player: I will try and ask your crush to join.

crab-hunting-returning-to-the-main-crab-.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-returning-to-the-main-crab-.text: What? No! You are not going to do that because I'm not going to admit to having a crush and you can't make me.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: A crab comes out shyly.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Hey there! I'm looking for ceremonial leaders to help my friend on the beach.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Oh. Sorry. You've come to the wrong crab!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: How comes?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: First, I'm a girl and girls are never ceremonial leaders. Besides, I get very nervous standing in front of others... I'm afraid to mess up.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: What if you do? Messing up is a part of life. You fall and pick yourself back up again.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: I know that, and yet I can't help it. I have this uneasy feeling that I don't belong... But I just really want to be accepted.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: I hear you.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: If only I could be more like...
The crab appears to turn bright red.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: You see, there's this one crab... He's kind and funny... and handsome! When he's around I feel like everything is going to be okay. But unfortunately, I can't even look at him!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Why not?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: For a start. I... get all red. In fact I get all red just thinking about him!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: It's really confusing how he makes me feel at ease yet so nervous at the same time. If I was a ceremonial leader and I spotted him... I would mess up for sure.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: No, the only way I can ever look at him is to steal some side glances...

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Wait. Since you walk sideways, which way IS a side glance?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: The way I'm walking! Which means if I try to walk towards him, I can't even look where I'm going!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: So I look at him from afar when he doesn't know I'm around. Yet among a thousand crabs on the beach, he's the only one I see.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Awww. I don't know which crab is the one that caught your eye, but you obviously like him. Hey, maybe he's a ceremonial leader this year?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: I already can't handle how awesome he is. If he was a ceremonial leader as well, how could I possibly approach him? I already can't!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: I clearly can't convince you to join, but the leaders will be practising on the beach if you wanted to check in advance whether the crab of your dreams will be playing.
And if he is, that might be your chance! Who knows! Maybe 'that crab you can't look at' only wants one thing: for you to look at him!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Very unlikely! But maybe I will take a peek. The good thing about being pessimistic is that you're happy when you're wrong!
The crab scutters away.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: I take it from your colour that he's around?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: Yes, and he seems to be playing an instrument I've never seen before! He is SO cool!
If the player said the instrument was a disaster:

steps.player: Ah, yes, the Disaster.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Hey, take that back, he's not a disaster!

steps.player: No no no! I don't mean he's a disaster. That's the name of the instrument I made for him!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: You made him an instrument called a disaster?

steps.player: I was only owning to the fact that it wasn't my best work, but the name stuck...

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: If the player said the instrument was a bass:

steps.player: Ah, yes, the bass.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That's not a bass! A bass is a type of fish! Also, what's with that accent?

steps.player: Believe it or not, that's exactly what he said.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: If the player said they did not know the name of the instrument:

steps.player: Ah, yes, the Banjo. He named it himself.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Wow! Is there anything he cannot do?

steps.player: Actually, yes. He can't play more than one note yet. It's just a matter of time, though!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: You know? I feel bad spying on him like this. I wish I could just walk to him and find out how he feels about me.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: What's stopping you?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: I am afraid of him not liking me, of course. But I might be even more afraid of him actually liking me!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: What if I'm... I don't know... not right for him? What if I end up hurting him one day?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: He might have an opinion on that. You two are going to have to figure this out. Together.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.text: I can't even approach him, let alone talk to him! And yet when I do manage to look at him... He feels like home, like where I ought to be. It's so confusing!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-palm-dire.player: Go to him once the ceremony has ended. If he spots you and blushes, then you've got nothing to lose. You've got this!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.text: No crab is coming out of the tree. Maybe they are too scared?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.player: Hello! My friend on the beach is looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.text: I... just want to retract my eyes and feel saltwater wash all over me. Taking me back to a time when I was a child and things were simple. Where the weight of life didn't feel so... heavy.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.text: I feel so trapped. I feel like I am about to moult, but the shell won't break. My thoughts are too big for me. I long to be tossed by the waves, helpless. Feel nature's wrath. Feel alive.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.player: That's deep. It sounds like being part of a community, making new friends and doing something meaningful could be really good for you. Be a ceremonial leader this year.
Practice is on the beach. What do you have to lose? Besides, the sea will only be a scuttle away if it doesn't work out.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.text: If the player has talked to the crab nicknamed "Dipper":

steps.player: Although the last crab that did that has been nicknamed Dipper ever since.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.text: The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-wes.text: Better. Playing coconut is tiring work, but it's kind of liberating. The sound drowns my thoughts.
If the crab at the red shell is present:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: My lovely neighbour is also really kind to me. She seems to care for me more than I can fathom.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Aw, shush! You looked like you were carrying the weight of a coconut. That's not right.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Your liveliness is making my day so much brighter, my load so much lighter. Who needs the sea when the sun is warmer?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Awwww. He's a keeper!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: No crab is coming out of the tree. Maybe they are too scared?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.player: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach who is looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: My, my, what do we have here? I have never seen one of your kin before.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.player: No? There are ruins on this island that look like they were made by my kind.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: Truly? Are you one of the ancient ones, whose tales have been passed downs for thousands of generations?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: Oh, what a great scientific discovery! Would you object to answering a few questions?
The crab pokes at your foot.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: So fascinating! Your carapace here seems to be very different from that of your upper limbs. Can I take a few measurements?
The crab starts measuring your foot with its claw.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.player: Listen... I just want to help my friend down on the beach. Are you willing to help?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: And miss out on the scientific discovery of the century! No, I must take notes.
The crab starts sketching on the bark of his tree.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.player: Okay, then I'll be heading off.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: So soon? Would you mind if I tagged along? For science?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.player: What will you take notes on if you leave the tree behind?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-north-eas.text: That is... very astute! I must note that down. Oh, before you go, can I have a carapace sample?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: Aaaaah! No! I'm too old to die!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: Being afraid has saved my chitin more than once, so I'll be afraid whether you like it or not!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.player: Er... Anyway, I'm here on behalf of my crab friend down on the beach. He is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him and his new instrument.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: Oh! Well, I'll pass as I'm not going. The ceremony is not worth the hassle.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: You spend ages travelling out to end up on a noisy overcrowded beach, crammed with crabs who climb all over you and don't respect you at all, you can't see anything, it's cold, and there's sand everywhere!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: And then when it's all over, you have to travel all the way back. You're exhausted and you wish you hadn't left home. I hate it. But you do it for the kids, right?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: Right! Not that you ever know which ones your kids are. We don't stick around to find out!

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: For all I know, you could be my kid.
If the player has already talked to the magic tree crab:

steps.player: I sincerely doubt that. Actually, talking to another crab, I was under the impression that lineage was very important to crabs.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Only for some! These stuck-ups aristocrabs once got lucky enough to get their claws on the magic tree, and now they think they are a gift to crabdom.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Passing it down through generations. Exclusive ceremony beach corners. Pah! Anything to feel superior.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: All it means is that they get to act like the rest of us are inferior. Yet I bet to seagulls, we all taste the same.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: If the player hasn't already talked to the magic tree crab:

steps.player: I sincerely doubt that.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: Anyway, I just want a year off from the ceremony. It's not too much to ask! I hear it's going to be even more crowded this year. Nobody will mind if I skip.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.player: Do ceremonial leaders get trampled too?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: No, they usually stay on the heights. We can't risk having the ceremonial rhythm be disrupted.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.player: So you would perform quite close to home?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: I suppose I would. But the practice takes place on the beach, doesn't it? It'd be a lot of effort to get back.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.player: What if I carried you back up once you're done practising? Would you consider it?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant.text: Hrm. Okay then, you've convinced me. I'll help.
The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant-tal.text: First time if the crab on the red shell is present:

steps.player: See, girl! I told you girls could be ceremonial leaders!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: You told me no such thing, and I am not a girl. She is, however.

steps.player: I can't tell you apart. That's really embarrassing.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-plant-tal.text: Subsequent times or if the crab on the red shell isn't present:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: After all this, I still had to trek all the way to the beach.

steps.player: But at least you're not getting trampled?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That is a small mercy.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: The crab stares past you serenely.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.player: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend over there. He's looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: The circle of life must continue.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.player: It must, yes. And so I wanted to know if you would be interested in joining? Practice is taking place... Right there.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: As the swallow carries the coconut, the body must toil.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: The path to enlightenment forgoes distractions.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.player: Does that mean you won't join?

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: A life not lived is a mind not opened.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.player: Does that mean...? Oh I give up.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: The crab serenely scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-western-b.text: The mind is quiet, the coconut is not.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.text: The crab clicks its claws threateningly.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.player: Hey there! I'm not here to fight. I'm here on behalf of my crab friend over there.
He is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him and make a cracking tune. He has a cool new instrument to use and good-sounding shells to share.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.text: Oh! Then I hope the ceremonial music will be better than last year. That time, the drums sent me into a trance and I walked right into the ocean instead of doing the dance. It was awful.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.text: I've been building amazing nests year after year and nobody cared. I went for a dip ONCE and now everyone calls me Dipper.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.player: Maybe becoming a ceremonial leader will help them forget about that? And you'd be too busy playing to accidentally go for a dip again.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.text: It's worth a shot. Okay, I will do it.
The crab scutters away to practise.

crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-investigating-the-eastern-b.text: Well, I've not earned a new nickname since starting practice. We'll see how that works out.

crab-hunting-after-finding-all-six-leade.player: Unless I really like talking to crabs, I've probably found enough leaders. I could go back to see how the practise is going.

crab-hunting-after-finding-all-six-leade.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-after-finding-all-six-leade.text: Pretty good! We've got enough leaders to practice properly. There's room for more, of course, but I expect if we don't look for them, they will come by themselves.

crab-hunting-after-finding-all-six-leade.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-after-finding-all-six-leade.text: It's up to you! You can continue talking to my kin and recruiting leaders or you can wait for them to turn up.

steps.player: Any idea where to look?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: I would check next to bushes and trees. You may find some of us hiding in some. We crabs can be scared of tall things which are not trees.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: If you struggle to make contact, you may want to make yourself flatter to the ground.

steps.player: Got it!

options.text: Wait for leaders to turn up.

steps.player: I've done enough talking. I'll wait here.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.player: I think I have found all of the crabs that were going to be leaders. I should go back to see how the practice is going.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.text: If every crab has joined practice:

steps.player: I'm afraid I've found all the crabs that were willing to assist.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Oh. To be fair, that is probably for the best. I don't think I have the nerves for the alternative.

steps.player: Is there a certain crab you wanted to be a ceremonial leader that isn't here?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: That's none of your business!

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Anyway, the whole band is complete! Thanks for your help.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.text: If not every crab has joined practice:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: The whole band is complete! Thanks for your help.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.text: I don't have much to offer in return, but maybe I could show you the ceremonial dance of my kin? Just promise me you won't do it during the ceremony.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.player: Why? Are you afraid I will become irresistible to a certain someone?

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.text: No, I'm afraid you'll trample us.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.text: I'm not sure how well this is going to work given you only have 2 legs.

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.player: Only one way to find out!

crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.speaker: Crab
crab-hunting-after-finding-every-crab-to.text: Let's go over there where it's a bit less crowded.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: The point of the dance is to make a sturdy sand nest.

crab-rave.player: That's definitely a skill I need to level up.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: You can sway and wave your claws in time with the music if you want to...
If the player has unlocked the Crab dance emote:

steps.text: The player begins doing the crab dance.

crab-rave.text: If the player has not unlocked the Crab dance emote:

steps.text: The player begins headbanging.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: But to be honest, the only thing that really matters...

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: Is what your back legs are doing.

crab-rave.player: I don't have back legs! Unless I put one at the front and one at the back, like this?

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: Use those legs to move the sand and gently and push it away.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: As you slowly turn around on the spot...
If the player has unlocked the Crab dance emote:

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Buddy, what are you doing?

steps.player: Swaying and waving my claws?

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Look, honestly, I don't think it's working out. Got any other moves?

steps.player: Awww... Okay, how's that?

steps.text: The player begins headbanging.

steps.speaker: Crab
steps.text: Better!

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: You can change direction once you've done a full rotation.
The penguin appears.

crab-rave.speaker: 'Crab'
crab-rave.text: Mission?
The player kicks the penguin into the ocean again.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: What?
The player resumes headbanging.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: Not really.

crab-rave.player: We are just drawing a circle.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: That's how it starts.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: But if you do it long enough, you have a nest.

crab-rave.player: I bet I can do it faster! Watch this!

crab-rave.text: The player spins onto the crab accidentally.
The player steps off of the crab.
The player begins crying.

crab-rave.player: I should have listened to you!

crab-rave.text: The crab emerges from the sand.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: Disputable.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: Somehow, yes. But anyways, we are done here. Thank you for coming to my demonstration.

crab-rave.speaker: Crab
crab-rave.text: Please never attempt this again.
The cutscene ends.

crab-rave-the-ceremony.speaker: Crab
crab-rave-the-ceremony.text: It's not long until the ceremony. We're going to get into position. Can you help us?
You carry the various instruments onto the heights... As promised, you also transport one of the crabs.
Whilst that music must sound absolutely amazing to crabs, it's a little too... avant-garde for your tastes. You choose to imagine different music instead.
The crabs run onto the beach.
The penguin appears a third time.
The player runs over to kick the penguin into the ocean again, accidentally stepping on some crabs in the process.

crab-rave-the-ceremony.player: Let's remain seated for the rest of the performance.

crab-rave-the-ceremony.text: The crabs dance for hours and hours...
As the day draws to an end, you suddenly feel very tired. You close your eyes...
As you wake up, you find some familiar-looking seashells...

crab-rave-the-ceremony.player: The crabs... Was it all a dream or did it actually happen?
I guess I will never know...

crab-rave-the-ceremony.text: If lost, you can collect your shell collection from the bottle, here, on Dognose Island.

crab-rave-reminiscing-at-the-bottle.text: The bottle is empty... You feel a sense of longing.
If you lost the shell collection:
As you look at the bottle, you notice familiar shells nearby. You collect them.

fP3Phx.speaker: Crab
fP3Phx.text: Actually, I've already got those. You can keep them.

tnqgmF.player: I was told, but I wasn't listening.

tnqgmF.speaker: Crab
tnqgmF.text: And you want me to listen to you? No. Begone.
